pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions (no averaging down); pyramiding is only authorized after a trade moves +$10.00 into profit and structural support/resistance is confirmed.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory execution pause of 15 minutes after any stop-out, and absolute block on entries during high-impact structural price velocity spikes unless confirmed by multi-timeframe order flow imbalance.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively secure green runs starting at +$15.00 via trailing stop activation, with a hard exit target cap at +$30.00.
